subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first Control UI slice, or require a broader daily/week calendar and drag-and-drop design before implementation?
rationale: Current main has no calendar/timeline, but the open PR covers only part of the requested feature and has product plus compatibility blockers that automation should not resolve as policy.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR on the current Control UI cron page, preserve current cron contracts, and treat daily/week/drag-and-drop scope as follow-up product work.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify timeline, daily, week, quick-stat, popup, and rescheduling behavior together.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Decide that the existing list and run-history UI is sufficient for core and close both the issue and linked PR with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR on the current Control UI cron page, preserve current cron contracts, and treat daily/week/drag-and-drop scope as follow-up product work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product-scope rather than a narrow code repair, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the top project maintainer.
